mix_frequency_estimate: AhJh on 3h7c5d facing 25% donk/cbet 4-way with CO+BTN behind: FOLD 70% / CALL 30%.
reasoning:
Multiway dynamic dominates the marginal-equity argument here. Hero is not just deciding 'pot odds vs equity'; hero is deciding 'pot odds vs equity AFTER multi-villain compounding'.

Multiway penalties applied to the raw 28-32% equity estimate:

(1) Two players behind, neither has acted on flop.
  - Prob CO calls: ~50%. Prob BTN calls: ~50%. Prob one raises: ~10-15%.
  - Expected players-to-river: 2.8 (UTG + hero + ~0.8 of CO/BTN).
  - Hero's equity in a 3-player pot at the river vs UTG cbet range + CO/BTN flat-call range: drops to ~22-25% (more ranges compete for the same equity, especially on running cards).

(2) Equity-realization OOP-against-call-stations is the worst-case.
  - Hero is IP relative to UTG but OOP relative to CO+BTN.
  - On turn checked-through, hero will face a value-bet from UTG and possibly CO/BTN; on turn UTG bets again, hero must FOLD all bluff-catchers (overcards-only is not a turn bluff-catcher).
  - Realization for AhJh in MW is ~0.65-0.75.
  - Realized equity = 22-25% × 0.7 = 15-18%. Right at pot odds 16.7%.

(3) Stack-pressure reverse implied odds.
  - Hero plays the rest of the hand with a marginal made hand if A/J turn.
  - On A turn: hero has TP-Jx kicker. UTG's cbet range has AA-99 overpair, A7/A5/A3 TPGK, AJ-AQ-AK that all crush AJ. Even when AJ wins, it wins small; when it loses, it loses big.
  - On J turn: hero has TP-Aces kicker. Similar story but worse: JJ-99 overpair, JT/JJ sets, AA-KK that crush.
  - On heart turn: hero has Ah nut FD blocker. Good news — UTG can't cbet a nut FD-bearing combo profitably from here.

(4) The donk-cbet from UTG is suspicious in MW SRP.
  - UTG opened, hero MP/HJ called, CO called, BTN called. UTG facing 3 callers on flop chooses to bet 2.5bb into 12.5bb (20% pot).
  - This is a SMALL stab into 3 villains. UTG's range here is more polar than a HU cbet — concentrated on (i) value (sets, two pair, overpair) and (ii) flush draws / strong-equity semi-bluffs.
  - UTG bluffing TT-99 or KQs/QJs is plausible at ~20-25% of cbet range.
  - This means UTG's value-heaviness is ~75% of cbet range, NOT 50% as in HU.
  - Vs polar value-heavy range, AhJh equity is REDUCED — ~25% raw equity (not 28-32%).

(5) Closing-axis confusion clarified: 'CLOSING' is the spot family label, but on THIS street hero is not closing. CO and BTN behind. Closing-on-FLOP applies only to BTN. Hero here has the WORST position relative to closing — 2 unknowns behind + facing PFA donk OOP-relative-to-PFA on later streets.

Class-level frequency for 'overcard-BDFD-A-blocker facing small cbet MW with players behind' on similar nodes (solver outputs in similar 4-way SRP nodes): FOLD 65-75% / CALL 25-35%.

AhJh combo specifically: the Ah-blocker is its main equity boost. Ah blocks UTG's AhKh, AhQh, AhTh — only 3 combos out of ~50 cbet combos. Modest effect. The Jh adds nothing (J is a dirty overcard).

Verdict: FOLD at MEDIUM-HIGH confidence. The consensus FOLD is correct under multiway pressure analysis. The CALL frequency is ~30%; AhJh is in the modal FOLD bucket. The screening report's '28-33% corrected equity' overstates the realized multiway equity (raw equity yes, but realization drops it to ~17-18% after MW penalties).
